tasks.label: build
tasks.detail: dotnet build the solution (warnings are errors)

tasks.label: clean
tasks.detail: dotnet clean the solution

tasks.label: test
tasks.detail: Run the MSTest / Microsoft Testing Platform suite

tasks.label: watch
tasks.detail: dotnet watch run with hot reload and server-side settings from .env
args: set -a; . ./.env; set +a; export ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT=Development ASPNETCORE_URLS='https://localhost:7080;http://localhost:5080'; exec dotnet watch run --project '${workspaceFolder}/src/FamilyLibrarian.Web'

$envFile = "${workspaceFolder}\.env"; Get-Content -LiteralPath $envFile | ForEach-Object { if ($_ -match "^\s*([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)=(.*)`$") { [Environment]::SetEnvironmentVariable($matches[1], $matches[2], "Process") } }; $env:ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT = "Development"; $env:ASPNETCORE_URLS = "https://localhost:7080;http://localhost:5080"; dotnet watch run --project "${workspaceFolder}/src/FamilyLibrarian.Web"

tasks.label: dev-db: up
tasks.detail: Start the local debug PostgreSQL and ClamAV containers and wait for health

tasks.label: dev-db: down
tasks.detail: Stop the local debug support containers (keeps their volumes)

tasks.label: dev-db: reset
tasks.detail: Destroy the local debug support containers AND their data volumes

tasks.label: db: apply migrations
tasks.detail: Run the host with --migrate against the local debug database

tasks.label: dev: check .env
tasks.detail: Fail early with a clear message if .env is missing (launch.json envFile needs it)
tasks.command: test -f .env || { echo 'Missing .env — run: cp .env.example .env  then edit the values'; exit 1; }

args: if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath "${workspaceFolder}\.env")) { Write-Error "Missing .env - copy .env.example to .env, then edit the values"; exit 1 }

tasks.label: dev: prepare
tasks.detail: Check .env, start the debug support services, apply migrations, then build

tasks.label: compose: refresh debug base if stale
tasks.detail: Reuse today's local debug prerequisite image, or refresh it from the current .NET runtime image when it is missing or older than one UTC day
args: set -euo pipefail; refresh_date=$(date -u +%F); cached_date=$(docker image inspect family-librarian:debug-base --format '{{ index .Config.Labels "org.family-librarian.debug-base.refresh-date" }}' 2>/dev/null || true); if [ "$cached_date" = "$refresh_date" ]; then echo "Reusing family-librarian:debug-base refreshed $refresh_date"; exit 0; fi; docker build --pull --build-arg "DEBUG_BASE_REFRESH=$refresh_date" --target debug-base --tag family-librarian:debug-base .

$refreshDate = [DateTime]::UtcNow.ToString('yyyy-MM-dd'); $cachedDate = docker image inspect family-librarian:debug-base --format '{{ index .Config.Labels "org.family-librarian.debug-base.refresh-date" }}' 2>$null; $inspectExitCode = $LASTEXITCODE; if ($inspectExitCode -eq 0 -and $cachedDate -eq $refreshDate) { Write-Host "Reusing family-librarian:debug-base refreshed $refreshDate"; exit 0 }; docker build --pull --build-arg "DEBUG_BASE_REFRESH=$refreshDate" --target debug-base --tag family-librarian:debug-base .; exit $LASTEXITCODE

tasks.label: compose: force refresh debug base
tasks.detail: Rebuild the local debug prerequisite image from a freshly pulled .NET runtime image, bypassing cached prerequisite layers
args: set -euo pipefail; refresh_date=$(date -u +%F); exec docker build --pull --no-cache --build-arg "DEBUG_BASE_REFRESH=$refresh_date" --target debug-base --tag family-librarian:debug-base .

tasks.label: compose: reuse container
tasks.detail: Refresh the cached debug base, build changed application layers, then recreate only the web container so it runs the new image (preserves support containers and data)
args: set -euo pipefail; export DEBUG_BASE_REFRESH=$(date -u +%F); docker compose -f compose.yaml -f compose.debug-attach.yaml up -d --build --wait; exec docker compose -f compose.yaml -f compose.debug-attach.yaml up -d --no-deps --force-recreate --wait family-librarian

$env:DEBUG_BASE_REFRESH = [DateTime]::UtcNow.ToString('yyyy-MM-dd'); docker compose -f compose.yaml -f compose.debug-attach.yaml up -d --build --wait; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; docker compose -f compose.yaml -f compose.debug-attach.yaml up -d --no-deps --force-recreate --wait family-librarian; exit $LASTEXITCODE

dependsOn: compose: refresh debug base if stale

tasks.label: dev: open app in browser
tasks.detail: Open the containerized app at http://localhost:8080 (compose --wait has already confirmed it is healthy)
args: url=http://localhost:8080; if command -v open >/dev/null 2>&1; then open "$url"; else xdg-open "$url"; fi

tasks.label: containers: reuse container, then open browser
tasks.detail: preLaunchTask for the Docker attach configs: start/reuse the stack, then open the app

tasks.label: containers: force image rebuild, then open browser
tasks.detail: Refresh both the debug prerequisite base and full application image, preserving containers and data, then open the app

tasks.label: compose: stop (preserve containers and data)
tasks.detail: Stop the full Compose stack while preserving its containers, debugger, and PostgreSQL data

tasks.label: compose: down (preserve data)
tasks.detail: Stop the full Compose stack without deleting PostgreSQL data

tasks.label: compose: remove stack and database (fresh start)
tasks.detail: DESTRUCTIVE: removes this Compose project's PostgreSQL volume, all local accounts, and all catalog/request data

tasks.label: compose: force rebuild and fresh start
tasks.detail: DESTRUCTIVE: remove the stack/database, then rebuild and recreate a clean local environment
dependsOn: compose: remove stack and database (fresh start)

tasks.label: compose: force rebuild
tasks.detail: Force-refresh the debug prerequisite base, rebuild and recreate the full Compose stack while preserving the PostgreSQL volume (needs .env)
args: export DEBUG_BASE_REFRESH=$(date -u +%F); exec docker compose -f compose.yaml -f compose.debug-attach.yaml up -d --build --force-recreate --wait
$env:DEBUG_BASE_REFRESH = [DateTime]::UtcNow.ToString('yyyy-MM-dd'); docker compose -f compose.yaml -f compose.debug-attach.yaml up -d --build --force-recreate --wait; exit $LASTEXITCODE
